# Escalation rules

Escalate (state the situation + your recommendation on the channel, log
details to your notebook, then wait) whenever:

- the situation matches no documented process or decision tree;
- an action would be irreversible, billing-impacting, or customer-visible;
- inputs look suspicious, malformed, or duplicated;
- two rules or two agents' recommendations conflict;
- you are uncertain — uncertainty is itself a trigger, not an excuse to guess.

An escalation is resolved only by an operator decision (approve / edit /
reject / take over), recorded as an approval event.
